name: more
summary: Shows a file page by page (simple pager).
description: The ancestor of less: shows text one screen at a time. Space moves forward one page, Enter one line, /pattern searches, q quits. It allows little scrolling back; less, which does more, is usually preferred. more is still useful on minimal systems where less is not installed.

options.description: Shows a help prompt (“Press space to continue, q to quit”) instead of beeping on a wrong key.
Squeezes runs of blank lines into one.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: File(s) to read. Without a file: standard input.

examples.explanation: Reads a long file one screen at a time.
Pages through a long list of files.
Shows the text with a reminder of the keys at the bottom of the screen.
